steps.title: Initialize Moto Hill Racer structure
steps.description: Setting up base directories and package directories matching com.motohillracer.app.

steps.title: Setup build.gradle for Moto Hill Racer
steps.description: Configuring dependencies, targetSdk 34, compileSdk 34 and minSdk 21 conforming to build guidelines.

steps.title: Create AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Declare package structure, default theme, set screen orientation to landscape and specify Launcher Activity.

steps.title: Create Game HUD and Menu Layout
steps.description: Define primary layouts for Main Menu, Instructions, High Scores, HUD, Controls and Game Over screens inside activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Implement custom physics GameView
steps.description: Building the main custom View rendering, including cosine interpolation landscape hills, bike controls, air/ground physics and collision detection.

steps.title: Write main game controller MainActivity
steps.description: Implement game lifecycle handles, touch listener bindings, game state routing, and persistent SharedPreferences high scores tracking.

steps.title: Configure App Metadata file
steps.description: Define app name and packagename parameters in app-meta.json metadata block.

steps.title: Establish Directory Tree Map file
steps.description: Map outline directories and build structures in directory-tree.json definition.

steps.title: Validate manifest parameters
steps.description: Verify xml namespaces, activity registrations, and reference icons to avoid deployment failures.

steps.title: Verify build target parameters
steps.description: Verify local gradle compiler parameters support SDK targets and JVM 1.8 compatibility layers.

steps.title: Check asset compilation dependencies
steps.description: Test drawing vector references on canvas inside GameView to confirm proper resource handling.

steps.title: Building Moto Hill Racer
steps.description: Execute build compiler and output production debug artifacts.
